name: Torrelapaja (Spain)
description: Red field with a hoist stripe edged yellow with two lobes bearing a black shield and a yellow wheat sheaf.
history: Municipal flag of Torrelapaja; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: hoist stripe with two lobed edges and a wheat sheaf
black shield in the upper lobe
wheat sheaf in the lower lobe
